notes.title: Patch Notes Oct. 09
notes.notes:
This is the first update since the release of Like Birds :) As I promised, I will keep updating bug fixes and quality of life improvements.

* Fixed camera clipping in certain situations
* Helicopter arrives sooner
* Stuttering in certain situation should be fixed/improved
* Moved climbable pipe to a more visible location, so players can find where to go easier
* Other fixes/improvements

Other than continuously working on fixes and updates, I'm currently working on a Linux port. I've already found out that the game runs without any issues with proton on the latest version of Linux mint, but I would like to make an official build.

Thank you.
